original_ai_output.title_zh: 尼日利亚联邦政府批准晋升27624名安全机构人员
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 尼日利亚联邦政府批准在尼日利亚安全与民防部队、联邦消防局、尼日利亚惩教署和尼日利亚移民局共晋升27624名人员。民防、惩教、消防与移民服务委员会秘书阿卜杜勒马利克·吉布林少将（退役）在阿布贾向记者通报了该委员会会议结果。其中尼日利亚安全与民防部队晋升17343人，尼日利亚惩教署4601人，尼日利亚移民局4097人，联邦消防局1583人。

key_facts.fact: 尼日利亚联邦政府批准晋升27624名安全机构人员
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The Federal Government has approved the promotion of 27,624 officers across the Nigeria Security and Civil Defence Corps, Federal Fire Service, Nigerian Correctional Service, and Nigeria Immigration Service.

key_facts.fact: 尼日利亚安全与民防部队晋升17343人
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: 17,343 officers of the NSCDC were promoted

key_facts.fact: 尼日利亚惩教署晋升4601人
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: the Nigerian Correctional Service had 4,601 beneficiaries

key_facts.fact: 尼日利亚移民局晋升4097人、联邦消防局晋升1583人
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: 4,097 officers of the Nigerian Immigration Service and 1,583 officers of the Federal Fire Service were also promoted

key_facts.fact: 该消息由委员会秘书在阿布贾向记者通报
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: disclosed this while briefing journalists on the outcome of the board’s meeting in Abuja on Thursday

uncertainties: 目前仅一个来源（Punch）报道，尚缺乏交叉验证
